title_zh: Guava：通过机器人操作 Harness 将前沿 VLM 蒸馏为紧凑智能体
one_line: SFT a 4B VLM on success-filtered GPT-5.4 turns plus perturbation branches in the identical tool harness; closed-loop sim, LIBERO-PRO and real-robot success.
one_line_zh: 在同一操作 harness 中用成功过滤的教师轨迹和扰动分支 SFT 4B 学生，仿真、LIBERO-PRO 与真机闭环验证。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate the models on 15 simulation tasks: seven seen tasks and eight unseen tasks spanning novel objects, instructions, and long-horizon compositions. Each model is evaluated over 30 trials per task using the full harness.

held_out_env.quote: unseen object tasks, which apply familiar manipulation skills to objects absent from training data; unseen instruction tasks, which require following novel goal specifications not encountered during training

title_zh: CaP-X：面向机器人操作的编码智能体基准与改进框架
one_line: Code-as-policy gym and benchmark varying primitive abstraction, multi-turn feedback and visual grounding across 12 frozen models; closed-loop simulator success per tier.
one_line_zh: 代码即策略环境与基准，在 12 个冻结模型上变化原语抽象、多轮反馈与视觉落地，按层级测闭环成功率。

online_eval.quote: Each task is evaluated with 100 trials per tier, where each tier specifies the available primitives, interaction mode, and feedback/grounding signal.

strong_baselines.quote: These 7 tasks are an intentionally controlled core for ablating abstraction, iteration, and grounding under matched conditions

component_ablation.quote: CaP-Bench isolates these axes via independently controllable tiers.

validator_check.quote: In subsequent turns, it explicitly describes differences between the previous and current image observations and whether the coding agent has completed the task.

evidence_level.quote: Each task is evaluated with 100 trials per tier, where each tier specifies the available primitives, interaction mode, and feedback/grounding signal.

S3.quote: Instead of directly emitting joint-space action commands, agents call motion planners or inverse kinematics solvers such as PyRoki ( Kim et al., 2025 ) . They can handle collision checking, reachability constraints, and action-space transformations

AP2.quote: We introduce the Visual Differencing Module (VDM), which uses a vision–language model to convert visual observations into structured natural language.

title_zh: 带 Harness 的编码智能体实现安全机器人控制
one_line: Coding-agent harness grounds obstacle boxes, verifies waypoint routes outside the model and picks obstacle-aware contact; SafeLIBERO and 2 real tasks, model-fixed ablations.
one_line_zh: 编码智能体 harness 在模型外用障碍框校验路径并选择避障接触方式，SafeLIBERO 与真机上做固定模型消融。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate SafeHarness on all 32 SafeLIBERO tasks with 10 seeds per task, and on real-robot using PiPER-X 6-DoF research arm for two tasks with 20 trials each.

variance.quote: We fix the 32 scenes and the ten seeds per task, so that every row rests on 160 episodes per level

strong_baselines.quote: Since both share backbone, tools, and skill memory, the gains isolate the harnesses.

budget_matched.quote: On SafeLIBERO, an episode is allowed at most 900 environment steps

component_ablation.quote: Rows add one harness at a time to Model + Skills (MS).

validator_check.quote: The verifier evaluates a single condition, namely whether the route intersects the obstacle, and it does so on an approximately measured scene.

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate SafeHarness on all 32 SafeLIBERO tasks with 10 seeds per task, and on real-robot using PiPER-X 6-DoF research arm for two tasks with 20 trials each.

S1.quote: Before any motion is issued, it is checked against the obstacle box outside the language model; the check covers the gripper and, when an object is held, the object as well.

S2.quote: A candidate that intrudes into the box is rejected and the model replans, until a route passes and is released for execution.

F1.quote: Other physical constraints that arise during execution fall outside its scope, and a route that passes verification may still fail against them.

AP3.quote: We fix the 32 scenes and the ten seeds per task, so that every row rests on 160 episodes per level

AP6.quote: The verifier evaluates a single condition, namely whether the route intersects the obstacle, and it does so on an approximately measured scene.

AP10.quote: On Libero-10 this loop runs twice per episode, once per sub-goal, and the second leg re-uses the obstacle box measured for the first.

title_zh: 以学生自身风格施教：面向网页智能体的黑盒教师蒸馏
one_line: Black-box teacher rewrites failed student web episodes from the first error in student style; weighted SFT with KL anchor; TimeWarp and live-web, 3 seeds.
one_line_zh: 黑盒教师从首个错误点按学生风格改写失败的网页轨迹，加权 SFT 与 KL 锚定，TimeWarp 与真实网页验证。

online_eval.quote: (a) TimeWarp (TW) ( Ishmam and Marino, 2026 ) , a containerized web benchmark with websites from different eras of the internet, and (b) OnlineMind2Web (OM2W) ( Xue et al., 2025 ) , a live web benchmark

held_out_env.quote: The performance transfers to unseen versions and to the live web in the OnlineMind2Web benchmark.

variance.quote: The average results of three seeds are reported with the standard error.

strong_baselines.quote: We evaluate (a) zero-shot, (b) vanilla behavior cloning on actions, and the TimeWarp approach on the full response ( Ishmam and Marino, 2026 ) , (c) outcome-based RL baseline using multi-turn Group Relative Policy Optimization (m-GRPO)

component_ablation.quote: Tab. 3 compares token weightings of the loss, with and without the KL anchor on the rationale.

evidence_level.quote: On the unseen versions v1–v5, WebKD beats the strongest baseline by 3.0–10.6pp.
